T1:
Task: replace session authentication with JWT authentication in a Django REST Framework API
Context: Django 4.2 and DRF backend; a new mobile app needs token login; refresh tokens must rotate on use
Constraints: Django admin, which needs session login, must keep working
Success: mobile client logs in, calls the API with access tokens and refreshes them with rotation; API endpoints no longer depend on session cookies; admin login still works
T2:
Task: find and fix why users are logged out after about 5 minutes despite a 2-week SESSION_COOKIE_AGE
Context: Django app moved behind an AWS ALB with 3 instances; logs sometimes show a new sessionid being issued per request
Constraints: sessions must stay valid across all 3 instances behind the load balancer
Success: sessions last the configured 2 weeks, whichever instance serves each request
T3:
Task: fix intermittent Playwright end-to-end test timeouts that fail about 20% of CI runs
Context: Next.js 14 storefront; suite passes locally but on GitHub Actions fails with "Timeout 30000ms exceeded waiting for locator('#checkout')"; retries make failures worse
Constraints: do not rely on retries
Success: suite passes reliably across repeated GitHub Actions runs
T4:
Task: make a flaky Jest test for a countdown banner React component deterministic
Context: the "shows expired" assertion intermittently fails; the component uses setInterval and date-fns; switching to Jest fake timers makes the test hang
Constraints: fake timers are the preferred approach but currently cause a hang
Success: test passes consistently on repeated runs without hanging or real-time waiting
T5:
Task: write a migration plan and runbook to upgrade a production PostgreSQL 12 database on AWS RDS to PostgreSQL 16
Context: about 800 GB of data; logical replication is the leading approach
Constraints: downtime of at most a few minutes
Success: a runbook with ordered steps, validation checks, cutover and rollback that keeps downtime within a few minutes
T6:
Task: add an index on (customer_id, created_at) to a 300M-row PostgreSQL orders table in production without causing an outage
Context: a previous index build held locks and took the site down for about 10 minutes; the table serves live reads and writes
Constraints: no long-held blocking locks; must be safe on a live database
Success: index is built and valid, with no outage or lock stalls for live traffic
T7:
Task: fix the Rust error "future cannot be sent between threads safely" when passing an async handler to tokio::spawn
Context: handler likely holds a std::sync::MutexGuard across an .await point, in a worker module
Constraints: minimal change; no large rewrite
Success: code compiles and the spawned task behaves as before
T8:
Task: write a reusable Terraform module that serves a static marketing website from S3 through CloudFront
Context: AWS; the site uses a custom domain over HTTPS
Constraints: private S3 bucket reachable only through CloudFront origin access control (OAC); ACM certificate in us-east-1
Success: terraform validate and plan pass, and apply serves the site on the custom domain with direct S3 access blocked
T9:
Task: diagnose why a Java service pod is OOMKilled in Kubernetes and tune the JVM for containers
Context: memory limit 1Gi and -Xmx768m, yet the pod keeps getting OOMKilled
Constraints: JVM settings must be container-aware; pod limit is 1Gi
Success: memory use is broken down by heap and non-heap, and the pod runs under normal load without OOMKilled restarts
T10:
Task: convert a Python library's packaging from setup.py and setup.cfg to pyproject.toml with the hatchling build backend
Context: library is currently built with setuptools; releases should publish to PyPI from CI
Constraints: version derived from git tags; PyPI trusted publishing (OIDC), no stored API token
Success: sdist and wheel build with the tag-derived version and the same metadata as before; a tagged release publishes to PyPI from CI
